description: This file defines the ConditionalStyles class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, responsible for managing and applying conditional styles, including conditional formatting rules and data bars, in XLSX spreadsheets.

classes.name: ConditionalStyles
classes.description: A class handling the reading, parsing, and application of conditional styles and formatting rules in XLSX worksheets within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ConditionalStyles object with worksheet, XML, and optional DXF styles.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and applies conditional styles from the worksheet XML.

methods.name: loadFromExt
methods.description: Loads conditional formatting rules from an extended XML and applies them using a provided style reader.

methods.name: setConditionalsFromExt
methods.description: Assigns parsed conditional rules to specific cell ranges in the worksheet.

methods.name: readConditionalsFromExt
methods.description: Reads conditional formatting rules from external XML elements, returning a structured array.

methods.name: readConditionalRuleFromExt
methods.description: Creates a Conditional object based on XML rule and attributes.

methods.name: readStyleFromExt
methods.description: Reads style information from external XML and converts it into a Style object.

methods.name: readConditionalStyles
methods.description: Extracts conditional formatting rules defined within the worksheet XML.

methods.name: setConditionalStyles
methods.description: Applies conditional styles to cell ranges within the worksheet.

methods.name: readStyleRules
methods.description: Converts conditional formatting rule XML into style objects for application.

methods.name: readDataBarOfConditionalRule
methods.description: Creates a ConditionalDataBar object from data bar rule XML.

methods.name: readDataBarExtLstOfConditionalRule
methods.description: Reads extended list of data bar properties and applies extensions to the ConditionalDataBar object.
